purpose.zh: 练肩膀往后打开时还能撑得住，前侧支撑用得上
purpose.en: Trains your shoulders to hold strong when they open up behind you.

text.zh: 手撑身后指尖朝后，手臂伸直，屁股慢慢往前滑
text.en: Hands behind you, fingers back, arms straight, slowly slide your hips forward

text.zh: 手掌贴死地面别动，滑到肩膀前面拉紧就停。
text.en: Keep your palms stuck to the floor, and stop when the front of your shoulders gets tight.

text.zh: 停住的时候手往下压地，肩膀往下沉、胸口挺起来；下巴微收，眼睛看前面。
text.en: While you wait there, press the floor, shoulders down, chest up; tuck your chin a little and look ahead.

text.zh: 撑住了再用手推着屁股慢慢滑回来。
text.en: Then push with your hands and slide your hips back slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 肩膀放松挂在那里，或者往耳朵那边耸
commonErrors.en: Letting your shoulders hang slack, or shrugging them toward your ears.

commonErrors.zh: 做得太快，一下一下往前冲
commonErrors.en: Going too fast and lunging forward.
Throwing your head back to look at the ceiling.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧刺痛就马上停，滑得短一点
cautions.en: Stop if the front of your shoulder stings, and slide less.

training.source: thomas-sup r2 animation tempo (8 s per rep: slide 2.2 s, hold 1.5 s, back 2.2 s, reset 2.1 s)

thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2: one rep 8 s (slide 2.2 s, hold 1.5 s, back 2.2 s, reset 2.1 s).
